worldcombat.skill.bravebird.summary: Tuck in the wings, spring to a low altitude and dive in a line through the target, landing beyond it; enemies along the line are struck in turn, each hit taking recoil. The high glide is heavier and longer, the low skim faster and safer.
Each enemy on the dive line takes one hit of about %1$s contact damage; the slanted line is %2$s blocks long, dived at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.

The user springs %1$s blocks up, starting lower when a ceiling blocks it; each pierced target reflects %2$s of its damage onto the user, up to %3$s targets can be pierced in one line, and each is carried %4$s blocks along the dive. The dive ends on landing once the pierce limit is reached, the distance is spent, or terrain blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.high.on: High glide: a higher spring, a heavier and longer dive, but heavier recoil and a slower wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.high.off: Low skim: hug the ground, faster and safer, trading power and reach down a step.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.growth.0: From level %1$s the dive power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.growth.1: From level %1$s the dive power rises to %2$s and one line pierces up to %3$s targets.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.use.0: Dive from the air straight through a target
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.use.1: Thread a line of clustered enemies on one dive
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.use.2: Reach the back line past the front
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.preference.h: On: a higher spring, a heavier and longer dive, but heavier recoil and a slower wind-up and cooldown - a longer set-up for a heavier blow. Off (low skim): hug the ground, faster and safer, trading power and reach down a step.
worldcombat.skill.bravebird.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in before taking off. Smaller only strikes up close, larger allows a longer run-up.
On: prefer the dive when another enemy stands in the corridor behind the target, threading a line in one pass. Off: rank by threat alone.
